title: Data Engineer
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 The Senior Associate Data Engineer is a developing specialist role, tasked with supporting the transformation of data into a structured format that can be easily analyzed in a query or report.
   

  

 This role is responsible for developing structured data sets that can be reused or compliment other data sets and reports.
   

  

 This role analyzes the data sources and data structure and designs and develops data models to support the analytics requirements of the business which includes management / operational / predictive / data science capabilities.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Contributes to the creation of data models in a structured data format to enable analysis thereof.
* Proactively supports the design and development of scalable extract, transform and loading (ETL) packages from the business source systems and the development of ETL routines to populate data from sources.
* Participates in the transformation of object and data models into appropriate database schemas within design constraints.
* Interprets installation standards to meet project needs and produce database components as required.
* Receives instructions from various stakeholders to create test scenarios and be responsible for participating in thorough testing and validation to support the accuracy of data transformations.
* Proactively supports the running of data migrations across different databases and applications, e.g. MS Dynamics, Oracle, SAP and other ERP systems.
* Support the definition and implementation of data table structures and data models based on requirements.
* Contributes to analysis, and development of ETL and migration documentation.
* Receives instructions from various stakeholders to evaluate potential data requirements.
* Supports the definition and management of scoping, requirements, definition, and prioritization activities for small\-scale changes and assist with more complex change initiatives.
* Contributes to the recommendation of improvements in automated and non\-automated components of the data tables, data queries and data models.


**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Knowledge of the definition and management of scoping requirements, definition and prioritization activities.
* Understanding of database concepts, object and data modelling techniques and design principles and conceptual knowledge of building and maintaining physical and logical data models.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Azure Data Factory, SQL Analysis Server, SAP Data Services, SAP BTP.
* Understanding of data architecture landscape between physical and logical data models.
* Analytical mindset with good business acumen skills.
* Problem\-solving aptitude with the ability to communicate effectively, both written and verbal.
* Ability to build effective relationships at all levels within the organization.
* Seasoned expert in programing languages (Perl, bash, Shell Scripting, Python, etc.).


**Academic qualifications and certifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications preferred such as SAP, Microsoft Azure etc.
* Certified Data Engineer, Certified Professional certification preferred.


**Required experience:**
* Moderate level experience in data engineering, data mining within a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with building modern data analytics solutions that delivers insights from large and complex data sets with multi\-terabyte scale.
* Moderate level experience with architecture and design of secure, highly available and scalable systems.
* Familiarity with automation, scripting and proven examples of successful implementation.
* Familiarity with scripts using scripting language (Perl, bash, Shell Scripting, Python, etc.).
* Moderate level experience with big data tools like Hadoop, Cassandra, Storm etc.
* Moderate level experience in any applicable language, preferably .NET.
* Familiarity with working with SAP, SQL, MySQL databases and Microsoft SQL.
* Moderate level experience working with data sets and ordering data through MS Excel functions, e.g. macros, pivots.


**Workplace type:**
 On\-site Working
   

  

**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R\&D.

 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
   

  

**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**
 NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason.  Do you thrive in dynamic, agile environments and enjoy collaborating with others?
   

  

**About The Programme**
 Our
 **Early Career Programme** 
 is your launchpad for a meaningful career in global financial markets engineering. This 12\-month journey is designed to build your foundational skills, connect you with world\-class talent, and expose you to live projects using cutting\-edge technologies.
   

  

**Eligibility Criteria:**
* Final year undergraduate or Master’s student, graduating by August 2027
* Pursuing a degree in: BE/BTech (CS/ IS/IT/AI/ML/DS/ECE) \& MCA
* Min 7\.5 CGPA throughout academics (10th/12th/UG/PG)
* No active backlogs at the time of application or onboarding
* Job Location: Bengaluru \& Hyderabad


 Roles in the Engineering apply deep technical and analytical expertise to build, operate and improve the platforms, products, services and models that power our business. Spanning software and platform, reliability, quality, cyber security, service operations, service management, financial engineering and data science, these roles work across the full lifecycle to solve complex problems, enable secure and resilient delivery, and drive continuous improvement in a product\-led, data\-driven environment.
   

  

**Job Profiles**
**Product Engineering**
* Roles in Software \& Platform Engineering focus on building and improving the software, infrastructure and systems that support our products and services. Engineers work across the full software and infrastructure lifecycle to deliver usable, maintainable applications.
* Quality Engineering roles help combine technical \& business understanding of systems, to uncover hidden weaknesses, ensure complete and clear requirements, and deliver robust systems that align with client needs, resulting in resilient and trusted products
* Roles in the Reliability Engineering track play a crucial role in identifying and reducing risks to performance and availability. They develop tools and implement strategies to prevent problems before they occur and recover quickly from a failure keeping platforms, applications, and services stable and reliable.
* Roles in Cyber Security protect our systems, networks, and data from security threats by assessing risks, designing and running security controls. They collaborate with teams in embedding security at every stage aligning to internal standards and external regulations.


**Service Engineering**
* These roles in Service Management manage the operational lifecycle of services, from onboarding to live production, using the ITIL framework and best practices to ensure services meet business needs. They ensure alignment to Service Management best practice focussing on service governance and oversight to align with standards, regulations and keeping operational consistency across the organization
* Roles in Service Operations focus on running systems and services with high availability and performance. Engineers monitor infrastructure, detect and respond to issues, and work across teams to maintain availability ensuring services stay online, recover quickly from failures, and meet agreed performance levels.


**Quantitative Analytics**
* The Data Science roles involve using statistical, analytical and computational skills in creating models, building tools and generating insights that solve real word problems. Both Data Scientists and ML Engineers are involved in operationalizing, scaling and integrating these models into robust systems and products.
* The Financial Engineering roles develop and implement models that help price, manage, and understand financial products and risks. Financial Engineers apply mathematics, programming, and domain expertise to design models that work in delivering accurate, reliable outputs and embedding models into the systems that manage financial data and transactions

 Associate

 and

title: Data Analyst
description:
**👩 💻 The role** 




 We're looking for a sharp, hungry analyst to join the data team at Headout. This is a foundational role, you'll work closely with senior analysts and leadership to build the reports, dashboards, and automations that power decisions across the company.
 



  





 Depending on where the need is greatest and where your strengths lie, you could find yourself working on growth and marketing analytics, product analytics, operations and supply\-side problems, or a mix of all three. The common thread: you'll be embedded in the business, working on problems that matter.
 



  





 This isn't about crunching numbers in a corner. You'll understand how our marketplace works, why metrics move, and what levers actually drive outcomes. You'll ship real work within your first week, and own meaningful workstreams within your first few months.
 



  





 If you're someone who gets restless when you're not learning, who'd rather figure things out than wait for instructions, and who cares about craft, this is for you.
 



  





**🤩 What makes this role special?** 



* **Real problems, not busywork** 
 : Headout is a global marketplace operating across dozens of cities, thousands of experiences, multiple currencies, real\-time inventory, and dynamic pricing. Whether you're analyzing conversion funnels, attribution models, supplier economics, or product experiments, the problems here are genuinely hard.
* **Breadth of exposure** 
 : You won't be siloed into one corner of the business. You'll see how growth, product, operations, and finance interconnect and build the analytical muscle to work across all of them.
* **Learn fast by doing** 
 : You'll pair with senior analysts on complex projects, get direct feedback from leadership, and see your work influence actual decisions. The feedback loops are tight, and the growth curve is steep.
* **A team that gives a damn** 
 : We care about speed and pragmatism over perfection, but we don't ship sloppy work. Feedback is direct and frequent. We document what we learn. We help each other get better.
* **A product you can care about** 
 : Headout helps people experience the best of every city they visit. There's something satisfying about working on a product where the output is someone having a great day somewhere new.



  





**💝 What skills \& experience do you need?** 



* 1 \- 3 years in an analytics, BI, or data science role
* Strong SQL skills, you can write complex joins, window functions, CTEs without hand\-holding. You know how to debug a slow query.
* Working knowledge of Python for data manipulation, automation, or simple analysis
* Hands\-on experience with at least one BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
* Nice to have: exposure to dbt, Airflow, or similar; basic understanding of data warehousing concepts
* Bonus: exposure to marketplace/e\-commerce, consumer tech

description:
**Company Description** **About Silvaco, Inc.**

**For over four decades, Silvaco, based in Silicon Valley, California and with global locations around the world has solved semiconductor design challenges by offering affordable and competitive TCAD (Technology Computer Aided Design) software, EDA (Electronic Design Automation) software, proven design IP (intellectual property), and world class support to engineers and researchers across the globe. Silvaco solutions span from atoms to systems: starting with simulation of material behavior impacting semiconductor devices, to design and analysis of transistor circuits, and lastly providing IP blocks for systems\-on\-chip (SoC) designs. Our solutions are deployed in production flows across broad industry segments such as leading display companies, automotive OEM suppliers, and top Memory, 5G, and IoT (internet of things) providers.**

 **Job Description*** JOB SUMMARY  

We are seeking a Compensation Analytics \& Organizational Design Analyst that is responsible for supporting Silvaco's global compensation programs, job architecture, workforce analytics, career framework development, and organizational effectiveness initiatives. This role provides analytical expertise to support compensation planning, salary administration, organizational design projects, and executive decision\-making.
* Job Description
Job Description


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES; include but not limited to:


	+ Conduct compensation benchmarking and market pricing analyses.
	+ Participate in annual compensation review cycles.
	+ Support salary structure development and maintenance.
	+ Analyze workforce trends and organizational effectiveness metrics.
	+ Assist with job architecture, job leveling, and career framework initiatives.
	+ Conduct workforce analytics and organizational modeling.
	+ Develop executive dashboards and workforce reporting.
	+ Support equity and long\-term incentive program administration.
	+ Manage compensation survey participation and analysis.
	+ Prepare compensation recommendations and business cases.
	+ Support organizational redesign and restructuring initiatives.
	+ Collaborate with HR Business Partners and Finance.
	+ Ensure data accuracy and compensation governance compliance.
	+ Contribute to executive compensation reporting materials.

 **Qualifications**  

QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Analytics, Business, or related discipline.
* 5\+ years compensation, workforce analytics, or organizational design experience.
* Advanced Excel and analytical skills.
* Experience with compensation survey providers.
* Knowledge of job evaluation methodologies.
* Experience with HR reporting and workforce planning tools.

 **Additional Information**

title: Power2Her Associate
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

  

About the Programme


Power2Her is HSBC India Bank’s first\-ever formal returnship programme that enables promising women professionals to return to work after a career break. Launched in 2021, it is a key initiative to augment the potential of women colleagues looking to restart their career. It is also an opportunity to attract great talent and strengthen future leadership pipeline. This is a structured 6\-month journey to build the mindset and skills to integrate back into work. The participants will be entitled to a standard monthly stipend for the duration of the program. Power2Her (P2H) has played a pivotal role in infusing diversity at mid to junior levels within the bank. We have deployed 56% participants into full time roles across businesses and functions.


Who are we looking for?


If you are looking to return back to work and fulfil the criteria below then please apply by clicking the button below and send us your resume. If selected, we will be in contact within the next 2 weeks to confirm your participation and further details. If it is not for you, but you do know someone that could be interested then please do forward this on and ask them to apply!

* Minimum 5 years of professional full\-time experience
* Out of the workforce for a minimum of 6 months
* Open to opportunities for 6 months’ contract roles based in India
* Previous career history in one of the following areas: Wealth Management, Relationship Management, Service Orientation, Corporate Banking, Investment Banking, Business Banking, Trade Finance, Cash Management, Securities Services, Custody, Asset Management Sales/Service/Operations, Data Analytics, Compliance, Risk Management, Operations, Finance \& Accounting, Internal Audit, Legal, Strategy, Sales, Marketing, Technology, Business Support, Supply Chain and Procurement
* Eligible to work in India
* Must be available to attend all workshops and events related to the program


How will we support the returners?

* A well\-rounded 6 months Development Plan with structured interventions has been carefully designed to support the transition of returning candidates.
* The returners will be invited to join two curated workshops on ‘Reboot your Career \& Personal Brand’ and ‘Communicate with Confidence \& Empowered Accountability’ to support assimilate into our culture and be provided with a mentor to help navigate the eco\-system better.
* A sensitization workshop for Line Managers is organized to help create awareness on their role and aspired behaviors when managing this group.

  

Programme Features:

* P2H returners are hired across organization levels and do not have a Global Career Band
* P2H returners are hired basis business demand throughout the year
* P2H returners are entitled to 10 days Privilege Leaves that should be pre\-approved on email by the Line Manager during the 6\-month internship duration
* P2H returners are entitled to the Child\-care allowance as per policy (where required)
* P2H returners are encouraged to apply on all internal \& external jobs that are advertised basis relevance of skills from the day of joining
* P2H returners can be converted for a Full Time role on a real time basis if the returner has performed well and shows potential as per business hiring needs


Application \& Selection process for the Power2Her programme:

* To apply for the programme, please visit our website and apply
* Submit your profile by completing 7 self\-explanatory steps. Once the profile submission and e\-signature step is completed. A link to complete the psychometric assessment will appear. Please take your time to complete the assessment
* Profiles of candidates who have cleared the assessment will be shared with Hiring Managers for further evaluation
* Shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews with respective business manager \& HR
* Pre\-Employment Vetting (PEV) checks will be initiated for the final selected candidate
* Employment contract for 6 months will be issued to the candidate with start \& end date post PEV checks completion which take about 2 weeks
* Induction invite will be sent with more details with the date of joining
* Experience Letter will be issued post 6 months’ program completion


Selection for Full time opportunities


Returners will be evaluated during the 6 months’ tenor. They will be evaluated for full\-time opportunities subject to performance and availability of suitable openings across businesses and functions. For more details on the programme, please reach out to rachna1\.mathur@hsbc.co.in


Reference Links


Testimonial Video Link: https://social.global.hsbc/umatube/videos/10673399

 **Additional Information**

 *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.*

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

  

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Background Verification Specialist / BGV - UK Europe
description:
The Background Verification Specialist is responsible for managing end\-to\-end pre\-employment screening and background verification activities for candidates across the UK, Europe, and Rest of World (ROW) geographies. The incumbent will ensure timely completion of background checks, regulatory compliance, stakeholder management, vendor governance, and resolution of verification discrepancies while maintaining excellent candidate experience.


The role requires close collaboration with Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Compliance, Legal, Hiring Managers, and external screening vendors to ensure all hires meet organizational and client\-specific onboarding requirements.


Key Responsibilities Background Verification Operations
* Manage end\-to\-end background verification process for hires across UK, Europe, Middle East, APAC, LATAM, and other ROW countries.
* Initiate and track verification requests through screening vendors and internal systems.
* Review completed background reports for accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
* Analyze discrepancies and coordinate adjudication activities.
* Ensure closure of all cases within defined SLAs before onboarding.

Verification Management
Coordinate and validate:


* Identity Verification
* Right to Work Checks
* Employment Verification
* Education Verification
* Criminal Record Checks
* Address Verification
* Professional License Verification
* Credit Checks (where legally permissible)
* Reference Checks
* Global Sanctions \& Watchlist Screening

Candidate \& Stakeholder Management
* Act as primary point of contact for candidates regarding BGV documentation and status updates.
* Partner with recruiters, HR business partners, hiring managers, and onboarding teams to ensure timely completion.
* Provide advisory support on country\-specific screening requirements.
* Resolve escalation cases and verification challenges.

Vendor Management
* Coordinate with global background screening vendors.
* Monitor vendor performance against SLAs.
* Conduct regular governance reviews and audit checks.
* Escalate delays and quality issues to vendor management teams.

Compliance \& Risk Management
* Ensure compliance with:
	+ UK GDPR

As a senior individual contributor, the role works across HR, Tech, Security, Legal, and vendors to ensure HR AI solutions are well designed, governed, and built in a way that improves experience and drives efficiency.

title: AI Strategies Implementation Technical Manager
description:
Hiring AI Strategies Implementation Technical Manager
 



 Experience: 14 to 20 Years
 



 Location: Hyderabad
 



 Notice: 0 to 30 days
 



  





**Strategy \& solution design** 




 Translates business problems into feasible AI/ML solutions; evaluates build\-vs\-buy vs. fine\-tune decisions; selects appropriate models, frameworks, and platforms (LLMs, traditional ML, computer vision, etc.) based on use case, cost, and latency needs; defines technical roadmaps for AI adoption across the organization.
 



**Implementation \& delivery management** 




 Leads end\-to\-end delivery of AI projects from pilot to production; manages scope, timelines, and resourcing across data science, engineering, and product teams; runs agile/iterative delivery cycles suited to the experimental nature of AI work; de\-risks projects by sequencing quick wins ahead of harder bets.
 



**Technical architecture oversight** 




 Ensures solutions are designed for scalability, maintainability, and integration with existing systems; oversees MLOps/LLMOps pipelines data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring; reviews architecture decisions around vector databases, RAG pipelines, model hosting (cloud vs. on\-prem), and API integrations.
 



**Data governance \& quality** 




 Ensures data pipelines feeding models are reliable, well\-governed, and compliant; partners with data engineering on data quality, lineage, and access controls; addresses bias, fairness, and representativeness in training data.
 



**Model evaluation \& risk management** 




 Establishes evaluation frameworks for accuracy, hallucination rates, and business KPIs; manages AI\-specific risks model drift, bias, security (prompt injection, data leakage), and explainability; ensures compliance with emerging AI regulations and internal responsible\-AI policies; sets up human\-in\-the\-loop review where needed.
 



**Vendor \& tooling management** 




 Evaluates and manages relationships with AI vendors and platform providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, etc.); negotiates SLAs, cost structures, and data privacy terms; benchmarks tools against internal needs.
 



**Cross\-functional stakeholder management** 




 Acts as the bridge between technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership; translates technical constraints and capabilities into business language; manages expectations around what AI can and cannot realistically do; drives change management and user adoption.
 



**Team leadership** 




 Manages or coordinates data scientists, ML engineers, and AI engineers; mentors team members on best practices; fosters a culture of experimentation balanced with production discipline; conducts performance reviews and skill development planning.
 



**Monitoring \& continuous improvement** 




 Sets up post\-deployment monitoring for model performance, cost, and drift; runs feedback loops to retrain/improve models; tracks ROI and business impact of deployed AI systems; iterates based on user feedback and changing data patterns.
 



**Security \& compliance** 




 Ensures AI systems meet data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, or sector\-specific rules); implements guardrails against misuse, prompt injection, and unauthorized data exposure; particularly relevant given defense/public\-sector context (Cubic), ensures alignment with frameworks like NIST AI RMF or DoD AI ethics principles.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Job Position** : Content Writer Intern

**Sector :** Food \& Beverages

**Position :** Internship

**Division :** Food and Beverages, R\&D Formulation Division

**Reports to:** FRL Business Operations Head

**About FRL:** Food Research Lab (www.foodresearchlab.com), a Unit of Guires Pvt Ltd. Guires is a leading global provider of advanced Contract Research, Development \& Pilot manufacturing organization (CDMO), and regulatory and intellectual property (IP) expertise. We are geared up to support and accelerate the development and pilot manufacturing for food, beverages, nutraceuticals, supplements, pet food and nutrition \& herbals development.

Travel Travels domestically to and from multiple facilities or worksites, often requiring overnight stays. Approximately 25% travel.

**Work Schedule**: Internship , Monday to Saturday, 10:00a.m. to 7:00pm. Hours may vary on occasion, depending on workload.

**Req. Qualification:** Currently Pursuing Master’s degree in food technology, Nutritional Science, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Chemistry, or related fields

**Req. Experience:** Fresher

A strong portfolio demonstrating technical writing, SEO content, and marketing\-related materials is mandatory.

**Req. Knowledge and Skills:** Strong understanding of food technology, R\&D, nutraceuticals, supplements, and pharmaceutical formulations.

* Familiarity with regulatory guidelines for food and pharmaceutical industries is a plus.
* Experience in industry\-specific forums and Q\&A platforms such as Qura to engage in discussions, stay informed on trends, and contribute to the industry knowledge base.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Content Development:

* Create high\-quality content such as blogs, articles, white papers, brochures, social media posts, and press releases relevant to the food and nutraceutical industries.
* Develop technical content focused on formulation processes, market trends, and innovations in R\&D.

SEO and Digital Marketing:

* Produce SEO\-friendly content to drive organic traffic.
* Contribute to email marketing campaigns and develop impactful social media content.

Collaboration:

* Work closely with subject matter experts (SMEs), scientists, and the R\&D team to ensure accuracy and depth of content.
* Partner with the marketing and design teams to ensure cohesive and engaging campaigns.

Editing and Proofreading:

* Review and edit content for grammar, tone, and adherence to the company’s brand guidelines.
* Update and repurpose existing content to align with current market trends.

Research and Analysis:

* Stay updated on industry trends, new technologies, and competitor strategies.
* Conduct market research to produce data\-driven and insightful content.
* Translate complex scientific data into reader\-friendly content for various platforms.
* Track industry keywords and contribute to the content strategy plan.

Job Type: Internship

Pay: ₹3,500\.00 \- ₹4,500\.00 per month

Language:

* Hindi (Preferred)
* English (Preferred)

****Job Summary****
 The Associate Data Scientist will work closely with Clinical Data Scientists to support clinical data collection, management, analysis, and reporting for algorithm development, regulatory submissions, and research initiatives.
   

  

 The role focuses on transforming clinical data into meaningful insights through statistical analysis, machine learning, and data visualization while ensuring data integrity and compliance with regulatory standards.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
**Clinical Data Management \& Analytics**
* Collect, clean, organize, and manage clinical datasets for:
+ Algorithm development
+ Clinical research
+ Regulatory submission activities

* Perform data manipulation, cleansing, validation, and analysis on large datasets.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of clinical data.


**Statistical Analysis \& Data Modeling**
* Apply statistical techniques including:
+ Regression analysis
+ Cluster analysis
+ Bayesian methods
+ Statistical testing
+ Probability distributions

* Develop predictive models and optimize classification algorithms.
* Apply machine learning approaches such as:
+ k\-Nearest Neighbors (k\-NN)
+ Naive Bayes
+ Support Vector Machines (SVM)
+ Decision Forests


**Machine Learning \& Algorithm Development**
* Support development and improvement of analytical systems.
* Enhance data collection methodologies to improve model performance.
* Assist in building predictive solutions for clinical and research applications.
* Evaluate model outputs and provide data\-driven recommendations.


**Reporting \& Scientific Communication**
* Conduct ad\-hoc data analyses based on business and scientific requirements.
* Prepare clear reports and presentations highlighting actionable insights.
* Support operational decision\-making through data interpretation.
* Communicate complex scientific and analytical findings effectively to stakeholders.


**Cross\-functional Collaboration \& Compliance**
* Collaborate with:
+ Clinical Data Scientists
+ Research teams
+ Data engineering teams
+ Cross\-functional stakeholders

* Support evidence\-based strategies and clinical data initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with:
+ Regulatory requirements
+ Data quality standards
+ Data integrity principles


****Required Experience****
* 1–3 years of experience preferred in Data Analytics, Data Science, Data Mining, Clinical Data Analysis, or related fields.
* Experience working with large datasets and analytical workflows.
* Exposure to healthcare, clinical research, pharmaceutical, or life sciences data is preferred.


****Required Technical Skills****
* Strong programming and scripting skills in:
+ Python
+ R
+ SQL

* Experience with data visualization tools:
+ Power BI
+ D3\.js
+ GGplot

* Knowledge of machine learning algorithms and statistical modeling.
* Understanding of:
+ Data preprocessing
+ Predictive modeling

+ Data interpretation


****Required Skills \& Competencies****

* Good understanding of statistical concepts and machine learning techniques.

title: Senior Enterprise Performance Analyst
description:
**About Care Access**
 Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all.
 **With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world\-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care.** 
 We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need,
 **and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.**
 With programs like
 *Future of Medicine* 
 , which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and
 *Difference Makers* 
 , which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.
   

  

 To learn more about Care Access, visit www.CareAccess.com.
   

  

**How This Role Makes a Difference**
 The Senior Enterprise Performance Analyst is responsible for analyzing, integrating, and delivering enterprise performance data and insights that support strategic decision\-making and operational excellence across the organization. This position develops and maintains performance reporting, dashboards, and analytical solutions that provide organizational leaders with meaningful visibility into key performance indicators, operational trends, and business outcomes. The Senior Enterprise Performance Analyst collaborates with cross\-functional stakeholders to identify reporting needs, transform data into actionable insights, and support continuous improvement initiatives. This role also provides technical guidance and mentorship to junior analysts, promotes data quality and analytical best practices, and contributes to the ongoing advancement of enterprise performance measurement and reporting capabilities.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
* Develop of dashboards and analytical reports that help monitor, maintain, and improve quality standards
* Analyze key performance data and identify levers that impact patient service and trial delivery
* Drive ad hoc and regular cadence analytics and reporting that supports current goals and business initiatives
* Work with leaders across the value chain to gather the necessary information to track organizational performance with the aim of addressing cross\-functional improvement opportunities
* Assist in formulating proper indicators across departments and lead team effort to produce data that will shed light on indicators, to understand execution performance, strengths and opportunities
* Provide business support to operations team as needed and interface with strategic customers when required
* Mentor jr. analysts and support in systems training around the organization.


**The Expertise Required**
* Excellent communication skills both verbal and written
* Advanced in Excel, SQL, and PowerBI
* Proven analytical and organizational skills to meet deadlines in an environment of often\-changing priorities, conceptual thinker comfortable with ambiguity
* A successful analyst must have high capacity for productivity, passion and curiosity to understand the "why", and ability to create and support a story based on quantitative findings


**Certifications/Licenses, Education, And Experience** 
  

  

* Minimum Education:
+ Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Computer Engineering, business, or another related field


**How We Work Together** 
  

  

- Location: This role requires 100% of work to be performed in a remote office environment and requires the ability to use keyboards and other computer equipment.

- Travel: This is a remote position with less than 10% travel requirements. Occasional planned travel may be required as part of the role.

* Type of Travel: National


 Physical Requirements: walking \<5%, standing 20%, and sitting 70%

* Paid Time Off (PTO) and Company Paid Holidays
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance plan options

title: Testing Engineer - Control Panel
description:
* Conduct routine testing of electrical control panels, MCC, PCC, PLC, VFD, APFC, and automation panels.
* Verify panel wiring, component ratings, terminal connections, and assembly quality.
* Perform insulation resistance (IR), continuity, high\-voltage (Hi\-Pot), and functional testing.
* Check control logic, PLC I/O signals, interlocks, and communication protocols.
* Validate panel operation as per approved electrical drawings and customer specifications.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and rectify testing\-related issues before dispatch.
* Prepare and maintain testing reports, inspection records, and checklists.
* Ensure all test certificates and quality documents are completed accurately.
* Maintain records of non\-conformities and corrective actions.
* Ensure panels comply with IEC, IS, and applicable industry standards.
* Follow quality management procedures and safety guidelines.
* Participate in internal quality audits and process improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with Design, Production, and Quality teams to resolve technical issues.
* Support customer inspections and Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT).
* Provide feedback to manufacturing and engineering teams for continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

* Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field.
* 2\-5 years of experience in control panel manufacturing, testing, or electrical quality assurance.
* Freshers with strong electrical fundamentals may also be considered.

Technical Skills

* Knowledge of electrical control panels, power distribution systems, and automation panels.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, GA drawings, and wiring diagrams.
* Knowledge of PLC, HMI, VFD, and industrial automation systems.
* Familiarity with testing equipment such as:
* Multimeter
* Clamp Meter
* Megger
* Hi\-Pot Tester
* Phase Sequence Meter
* Understanding of IEC, IS, and electrical safety standards.

Key Competencies

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Attention to detail and quality\-focused approach.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to work under deadlines and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in Industrial Automation or Control Panel Manufacturing.
* Exposure to Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).
* Knowledge of Schneider, Siemens, ABB, Mitsubishi, Allen Bradley, or similar automation products.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:

* Configure modules, workflows, user roles, and access permissions based on client requirements.
* Support project planning, timelines, and implementation milestones.
* Coordinate testing, deployment, and go\-live activities.

Client Interaction \& Requirement Gathering

* Document business processes and map them to software functionalities.

title: CCTV Engineer
description:
Are you passionate about security technology and ensuring the safety of others? We're seeking a skilled CCTV Technician to join our team. As a CCTV Technician, you'll be responsible for installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting closed\-circuit television (CCTV) systems for our clients. Your attention to detail, technical expertise, and commitment to quality will play a crucial role in safeguarding our clients' properties and assets.

Responsibilities:

* Install, configure, and maintain CCTV systems, including cameras, monitors, recording equipment, and networking components.
* Conduct site surveys to assess security needs and determine the most effective placement of CCTV equipment.
* Program and integrate CCTV systems with other security systems, such as access control and alarms, to provide comprehensive security solutions.
* Troubleshoot technical issues with CCTV equipment, including diagnosing and resolving hardware and software problems.
* Perform routine maintenance and inspections of CCTV systems to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
* Provide training and support to clients on the operation and maintenance of CCTV systems.
* Keep abreast of industry trends, advancements, and best practices in CCTV technology.

Requirements:

* Proven experience as a CCTV Technician or similar role.
* Proficiency in installing and configuring CCTV equipment and software.
* Strong understanding of networking principles and IP\-based CCTV systems.
* Familiarity with different types of CCTV cameras, lenses, and accessories.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings and schematics.
* Excellent troubleshooting skills and attention to detail.
* Effective communication and customer service skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CCTV Installation Certification) are a plus.
* Valid driver's license and clean driving record.

Join our team and play a key role in enhancing the security and safety of our clients' environments. Apply now to become our next CCTV Technician!

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

title: Front Office & Admin Executive
description:
**Job Summary**

The Front Office \& Admin Executive is responsible for managing the reception area, handling day\-to\-day administrative tasks, and ensuring smooth office operations. In a FinTech environment, this role also supports coordination across departments, maintains confidentiality of sensitive financial data, and delivers a professional first impression to clients, partners, and stakeholders.

**Key ResponsibilitiesFront Office Management**

* Greet and assist visitors, clients, and vendors in a professional manner
* Handle incoming calls, emails, and correspondence
* Maintain visitor logs and issue access badges as per security protocols
* Schedule and coordinate meetings, appointments, and conference rooms

**Administrative Support**

* Manage office supplies, inventory, and vendor relationships
* Handle courier services, mail distribution, and documentation
* Maintain records, files, and databases (both physical and digital)
* Support onboarding logistics for new employees (ID cards, workspace setup, etc.)

**Office Operations**

* Ensure cleanliness, organization, and functionality of office premises
* Coordinate with IT, facilities, and housekeeping teams
* Monitor office equipment and arrange repairs/maintenance
* Assist in organizing company events, meetings, and training sessions

**Compliance \& Confidentiality (FinTech\-Specific)**

* Handle sensitive financial and client information with strict confidentiality
* Ensure adherence to company policies, data protection, and security guidelines
* Support documentation required for audits and regulatory compliance

**Coordination \& Communication**

* Act as a point of contact between departments
* Assist HR and finance teams with administrative tasks
* Maintain internal communication and announcements

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Intermediate and Above
* Freshers are also welcome, Also 0\-2 years of experience in front office or administrative roles (preferably in FinTech, BFSI, or tech companies) is preferable
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
* Professional appearance and customer\-oriented mindset

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with office management tools or CRM systems
* Basic understanding of financial services or FinTech operations
* Familiarity with data privacy standards and compliance practices

**Key Competencies**

* Attention to detail
* Time management
* Problem\-solving skills
* Confidentiality and integrity

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**

**Experience**:

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do from feeding our flocks to our customers. If you want to make a meaningful impact in the agri\-food sector and help us deliver healthy products across communities, **join our growing team!**

**Job Summary:**

The Veterinary Assistant at Legit Farms will support the daily health, care, and welfare of all poultry and livestock on the farm. This role involves assisting the veterinarian/ farm manager in routine health checks, administering medications, maintaining hygiene standards, and monitoring animal behaviour to ensure optimal farm productivity and biosecurity.

* Assist in daily health monitoring of birds and livestock, reporting abnormalities immediately.
* Support the farm manager during examinations, treatments, and vaccination programs.
* Administer medicines, feed supplements, and vaccinations as instructed.

* Ensure cleanliness and sanitization of sheds, equipment, feeding areas, and water lines.

* Assist in egg collection, grading, and handling procedures when required.
* Observe animal behaviour to detect early signs of illness or stress.
* Support in managing injured, sick, or isolated birds as per protocol.
* Coordinate with the feed preparation team to ensure proper feed quality and timely distribution.
* Maintain veterinary supplies and report requirements for medicines, vitamins, and equipment.
* Follow safety guidelines and ensure compliance with farm policies.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* Diploma/Certification in Veterinary Science, Animal Husbandry, or related field (Required).

* Basic knowledge of animal health, vaccination schedules, and farm hygiene practices.
* Ability to handle birds and livestock safely and confidently.
* Strong observation skills and attention to detail.
* Physically fit and able to perform farm\-related tasks.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts and rural farm conditions.

**Key Competencies**

* Responsibility and discipline
* Observational accuracy

title: MIS & Compliance Intern
description:
**Job Description: MIS \& Compliance Intern** 




  





**Location** 
 : Delhi / NCR
 



**Employment Type** 
 : Internship
 



  





**About Kamakhya Analytics** 




 Kamakhya Analytics is a technology\-driven research and consulting organisation helping leaders, parties, and institutions decode India’s political and policy landscape.We bring together survey science, data analytics, and strategic insight to answer complex questions about public opinion, governance, and performance. From ground\-level fieldwork to advanced modelling and interpretation, every project is built for clarity, accuracy, and impact. Our teams manage the complete research cycle — design, execution, data engineering, and delivery — under a single framework of discipline, transparency, and speed. Quality and integrity define our work. We apply rigorous controls in sampling and verification, maintain secure and reproducible data systems, and communicate results that withstand scrutiny.
 



  





**About Team** 




 The Operations Compliance Team plays a critical role in ensuring that all operational activities are executed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with the organization's policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and regulatory requirements. The team acts as the central control function for operational quality, data integrity, and process governance, helping maintain transparency, accountability, and business continuity.
 



  





 This vertical is responsible for:
 


* Operations Compliance \& Governance: Ensuring all operational activities comply with company policies, SOPs and regulatory requirements while maintaining proper documentation and audit records.
* MIS \& Data Management: Managing data accuracy through validation, preparing MIS reports and dashboards, and providing insights to support operation decisions.
* Process Monitoring \& Risk Management: Monitoring operational processes, conducting audits, identifying compliance gaps, managing operational risks, and escalating critical issues when required.
* Issue Resolution \& Coordination: Resolving operational discrepancies, payment\-related issues, and data mismatches by working closely with Operations, Vendor, Finance, HR and other stakeholders.
* Process Improvement \& Automation: Continuously improving workflows by identifying automation opportunities, streamlining processes and enhancing operational efficiency.



  





**About The Role** 




 We are looking for an MIS \& Compliance Intern to support the Operations Compliance team by managing MIS reports, ensuring data accuracy, and monitoring compliance with company processes and SOPs.
 



 This role plays a key part in maintaining operational efficiency and providing reliable data for operation decisions. You will work centrally with teams across multiple states, coordinating with Operations, Finance, Admin, Vendor and other stakeholders to resolve operational issues, ensure smooth communication, monitor performance, and drive continuous process improvements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Employee Documentation \& Compliance** 



* Prepare and manage employee ID cards, employment contracts, contract renewals, and contract verification.
* Verify onboarding documents to ensure compliance with company policies and documentation standards.
* Maintain accurate employee records and ensure timely updates.



  





**2\. MIS Reporting \& Data Management** 



* Prepare and maintain daily MIS reports, trackers, and operational dashboards.
* Monitor data accuracy, resolve reporting issues, and ensure timely submission of operational reports.
* Validate operational data to support informed operation decisions.



  





**3\. Daily Operations Monitoring** 



* Track daily employee attendance and verify attendance records for accuracy and compliance.
* Monitor daily operational activities, identify discrepancies, and coordinate with stakeholders for timely resolution.
* Maintain and monitor cab activity trackers, ensuring accurate records and timely updates.
* Support continuous process improvements by identifying gaps and recommending efficient tracking and reporting practices.



  





**4\. Payment Tracking \& Validation** 



* Track daily transaction/amount processing, perform validations, and resolve data mismatches to ensure operational accuracy.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience Skills \& Tools** 



* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX\-MATCH, QUERY, FILTER, IMPORTRANGE, dashboards and reporting).
* Familiarity with attendance management and operational data validation.
* Knowledge of document management, employee onboarding, and contract administration.
* Basic knowledge of process automation and reporting tools (Looker studio, App script).



  





**Experience** 



* 1–2 years of experience in MIS, Operations, Compliance, Administration, or a similar role.
* Freshers with strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets may also apply.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Drive Operational Excellence: Play a key role in ensuring accurate MIS reporting, compliance, and smooth operational processes across the organization.
* High Impact Role: Your work will directly support business decisions, improve process efficiency, and maintain data integrity across multiple states.
* Growth \& Learning: Enhance your expertise in MIS, compliance, data analysis, process automation, and operational governance while building a strong career in operations.
* Ownership \& Responsibility: Take ownership of critical operational processes, employee documentation, compliance monitoring, and business reporting.
