title: Senior Manager, Ads and Marketing Data Science
description:
**About The Team**
 As a Senior Manager within Marketing Analytics \& Data Science at Zillow Group, you’ll lead a team at the heart of how Zillow’s marketing organization makes data\-driven decisions. Our team builds and maintains measurement frameworks, causal models, and analytical infrastructure that directly inform marketing budget allocation, channel strategy, and growth planning. Based in India, this role leads a team of data scientists who work in close partnership with Zillow’s global Marketing, Product, and Engineering stakeholders. The work this team does—spanning Marketing Mix Modeling, incrementality testing, attribution, and performance analytics—directly shapes how Zillow invests in reaching customers across one of life’s biggest milestones.
   

  

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** 
 Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Zillow Group is seeking a Senior Manager of Data Science to lead and grow the India\-based Marketing Analytics \& Data Science team. This is a people leadership role grounded in deep technical expertise in marketing measurement, MMM, and traditional marketing analytics. You will be responsible for building a high\-performing team, owning the measurement strategy for Zillow’s core marketing programs, and serving as the primary data science partner to senior marketing and business stakeholders.
   

  

 This role operates at the intersection of marketing science, causal inference, and scalable analytics infrastructure. You will shape how the team approaches marketing effectiveness measurement while building the processes, culture, and capabilities needed to make the India team a foundational part of Zillow’s global Marketing Data Science organization.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to build and lead a world\-class data science team in India while working on analytically challenging, globally significant marketing science problems. You’ll partner across geographies, influence how Zillow invests its marketing dollars, and develop data scientists who go on to have meaningful careers at a globally recognized technology company.
   

  

 This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

 You are a technically strong and commercially minded data science leader with deep expertise in marketing measurement and analytics. You understand how MMM, attribution, and causal inference connect to real marketing investment decisions, and you have the leadership presence to influence how those decisions get made. You combine statistical rigor with the ability to develop people, manage complex cross\-functional relationships, and drive delivery in a distributed team environment. You are comfortable operating as both a strategic thought partner to senior stakeholders and a hands\-on technical reviewer for your team’s most challenging work.
   

  

 You bring experience from organizations where marketing analytics is taken seriously—whether that’s a global technology company, an Indian consumer tech company, a data\-driven marketing organization, or a specialist analytics firm. You understand the discipline of marketing science and the craft of building teams that do it well.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in data science, marketing analytics, or applied measurement, with 4\+ years directly managing and developing data scientists.
* Deep expertise in Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM): methodology, tooling, business integration, and stakeholder communication.
* Strong working knowledge of marketing attribution, incrementality testing, and causal inference methods (geo\-testing, diff\-in\-diff, synthetic controls, uplift modeling).
* Experience with performance forecasting and budget optimization in a marketing context.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a team of data scientists—setting direction, developing careers, and maintaining a high bar for quality and impact.
* Proven ability to manage and influence senior stakeholders across functions and geographies.
* Strong executive communication skills: comfortable presenting complex methodology and business implications to senior marketing and business leaders.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and Python or R; experience operating in production analytics environments.
* Comfort operating in a globally distributed team environment with US\-based counterparts.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience at a high\-growth Indian consumer tech company
* Exposure to offline marketing analytics, brand measurement, or upper\-funnel attribution.
* Experience scaling and modernizing legacy marketing measurement infrastructure.
* Familiarity with dbt, Databricks, Snowflake, Airflow, or comparable data infrastructure.
* Experience building or managing analytics teams across multiple geographies.


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* You build measurement frameworks that marketing leaders actually use to make decisions—not just deliver reports
* You develop high\-performing teams, not just high\-performing models
* You communicate across the spectrum—from walking an analyst through a causal design to presenting budget implications to a CMO
* You hold a high bar for analytical credibility while being pragmatic about delivery timelines
* You build strong cross\-geography partnerships and make distributed teams work effectively
* You stay technically grounded even as your scope grows—you know when to go hands\-on and when to step back


 Get to know us
   

  

 At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.
   

  

 As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience.
   

  

 Whether you’re working in tech, operations, or shared services, you’ll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality.
   

  

 Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
   

  

 No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
   

  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, maternity status, HIV status, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to candidates with disabilities, in accordance with applicable policies.*

EroNkan serves food and beverage, FMCG packaging, and flexible packaging industries through tailored solutions that enable real\-time monitoring, machine parameter tracking, and automated KPI dashboards. The organization focuses on converting factory data into measurable business impact rather than just providing traditional dashboards or software. Responsibilities include configuring and maintaining field devices and sensors, connecting controllers and edge devices (such as Raspberry Pi) to the IoT ecosystem, and ensuring reliable communication across machines and shop\-floor networks. Candidates should possess hands\-on experience with hardware platforms such as Raspberry Pi and similar edge\-computing devices used for data collection, control, and gateway functions. Candidates should possess foundational knowledge of Inductive Output Tube (IOT) or related industrial components, and be comfortable working with control panels, sensors, actuators, and industrial communication interfaces. Relevant qualifications include a degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or related engineering fields; experience in industrial automation, SCADA, and PLC\-based control systems is highly beneficial.  The Product Manager at iDream Education sits at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and the field. You will define what gets built, ensure it is built right, and make sure it solves real problems for the students, teachers, and administrators who use our products every day.
   

  

 You will work across both internal tools and the iPrep suite of products — partnering closely with design, engineering, ops, content, and sales, as well as with field counterparts — leading roadmap planning and prioritisation in close partnership with the founders.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities \& Deliverables


**Own the Spec Layer**
* Translate requests from ops, content, sales, and marketing into clear, structured product requirements before they reach engineering.
* Define acceptance criteria, timelines, and priorities for every piece of work entering the engineering pipeline.
* Eliminate ambiguity as a default — no ticket moves to development without a written spec.


**Bridge Design and Engineering**
* Work closely with the design team to drive iterations to finality — own sign\-off gates so engineering always builds against confirmed designs.
* Be the single point of accountability for design\-to\-development handoffs.
* Reduce rework by making design decisions explicit and time\-bound.


**Stakeholder Interface**
* Be the primary point of contact for internal teams — ops, content, sales, marketing — channelling their needs into the product process.
* Interface with field counterparts and school\-level stakeholders to surface ground realities and unvoiced user needs.
* Represent product context clearly across very different audiences — from engineers to field coordinators.


**Roadmap Planning and Prioritisation**
* Lead roadmap planning in close partnership with the founders — synthesising inputs from internal teams, field signals, and usage data.
* Identify unvoiced opportunities: gaps that no one is articulating yet but that the data or field context reveals.
* Work with our data analysts to bring usage evidence into prioritisation discussions — not just instinct.
* Qualifications \& Experience


**Education:** 
 Graduate in any discipline; a background in Product Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field is preferred. However, candidates with a strong track record in product management, product strategy, or cross\-functional product development will also be considered regardless of their specific degree.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 3–5 years of experience in Product Management, preferably in a technology, SaaS, EdTech, or digital product environment. A proven track record includes successfully defining product requirements, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, driving product launches, and delivering measurable business and user outcomes through data\-driven product decisions.
   

  

**Other Requirements:** 
 Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet product delivery timelines. Strong collaboration with engineering, design, business, and other stakeholders is essential. This is primarily an office\-based role located in Gurugram, Haryana, with minimal travel as required for customer interactions, workshops, or business meetings.
   

  

* Key Skills \& Competencies
* 3–5 years of total relevant experience, with at least 1–2 years directly in a product team (as PM, Associate PM, Business Analyst, or similar adjacent role).
* You have been a member of a product team — you understand how good product development works from the inside, even if PM wasn’t your exact title.
* You write with structure and clarity. Your specs, briefs, and updates leave no room for misinterpretation.
* You are comfortable with data — you can pull the right numbers, read them honestly, and use them to make a case or change your mind.
* You thrive in environments where influence matters more than authority. You can align people who don’t report to you.
* You are energised by working closely with founders — you see it as an advantage, not a constraint.
* You genuinely care about the problem: quality education reaching every child, iregardless of where they grow up.
* You are coachable and self\-aware — you know what you don’t know, and you’re not threatened by it.
* What We're Looking For — Values \& Culture Fit
* Integrity: Makes transparent, data\-driven product decisions and takes ownership of outcomes.
* Impact: Builds products that solve real customer problems and drive measurable business value.
* Excellence: Continuously improves the product through user insights, data, and innovation.
* Collaboration: Works seamlessly with cross\-functional teams to deliver successful product outcomes.
* Why Join Us


 This is a high\-ownership role at the center of our product development, where your work directly bridges the gap between field realities and engineering execution. You will partner closely with the founders to shape the roadmap of the iPrep suite, ensuring our products solve real\-world problems for students and teachers across India. Join us to build, measure, and scale solutions that make "Unlimited Learning" a reality for every child, while advancing your product leadership in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment.

description:
Software Engineer

 What is the Technical Writer?
   

  

 A technical writer is a professional who specializes in creating and editing documents that explain complex technical information in a clear and concise manner. These professionals are skilled at translating technical jargon into language that is easily understood by the intended audience, whether it be users, customers, or employees. Technical writers often work closely with subject matter experts to gather information and ensure accuracy in their documentation. In summary, a technical writer plays a crucial role in bridging the gap between technical knowledge and user comprehension through effective communication.
   

  

 Technical Writer salary in Bay Area and US?
   

  

 The salary of a Technical Writer in the Bay Area tends to be higher than the national average for this profession in the United States. According to data from Glassdoor, the average base salary for a Technical Writer in the Bay Area is around $80,000 per year, while the national average is approximately $60,000 per year. Factors such as experience, industry, and company size can also impact salary levels for Technical Writers in both the Bay Area and the US.
   

  

**Skillset Required For Technical Writer**
 The skillset required for a Technical Writer includes strong writing and communication skills, attention to detail, the ability to understand complex technical information, research skills, and proficiency in using various tools and software. Technical Writers must be able to translate technical jargon into clear and concise language that is easily understood by their target audience. They also need to be organized, adaptable, and able to work well under pressure to meet deadlines. In addition, having knowledge of the subject matter they are writing about can be beneficial. Overall, a successful Technical Writer needs a combination of writing prowess, technical aptitude, and a keen eye for detail to effectively convey complex information to readers.
   

  

 Experience level for Technical Writer
   

  

 The experience level required for a technical writer can vary depending on the specific industry and type of technical writing involved. Generally, employers look for candidates with a bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as English, communications, or engineering. Entry\-level positions may require little to no prior experience, but proficiency in writing, research, and technical skills is essential. Mid\-level technical writers typically have 2\-5 years of experience and may be expected to have expertise in specific technical areas or industries. Senior technical writers usually have 5\+ years of experience, with a proven track record of producing high\-quality technical documentation and leading projects. In conclusion, while some entry\-level positions are available, having a few years of experience can greatly enhance job prospects and opportunities for advancement in the field of technical writing.
   

  

 Top 3 ranking skills for Technical Writer
   

  

 The top three ranking skills for a technical writer are strong writing abilities, technical expertise, and excellent communication skills. A technical writer must be able to convey complex information in a clear and concise manner, so having exceptional writing skills is crucial. Additionally, having a solid understanding of technical concepts and being able to translate them into easily understandable language is essential. Lastly, effective communication skills are necessary for collaborating with subject matter experts and stakeholders to gather information and ensure accuracy in the documentation.
   

  

**Additional Knowledge Or Experience For Technical Writer**
* Strong understanding of technical concepts and terminology
* Proficiency in writing clear and concise technical documentation
* Familiarity with industry\-standard tools and software for technical writing


 Number of Technical Writer jobs in US
   

  

 The number of technical writer jobs in the United States has been steadily increasing over the years, reflecting the growing demand for professionals who can effectively communicate complex technical information to a wide audience. With the rapid advancement of technology and the digital age, the need for skilled technical writers has become more prominent in various industries such as software development, engineering, healthcare, and finance. According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, the employment of technical writers is projected to grow 7% from 2019 to 2029, faster than the average for all occupations. This indicates a positive outlook for individuals seeking opportunities in this field.

 Mobile app developers create applications for mobile devices like smartphones and tablets. They design, develop, and test mobile apps for iOS and Android platforms.

 Application Areas of Software Development

title: Software Engineer - Agent Eval & Harness
description:
Lexsi Labs is the leading frontier AI lab focused on building aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems. While that is the vision, the mission is to build safety aware autonomous systems in the extreme near term. Our research work spans areas like AI alignment methodologies, interpretability\-led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and new autonomous system designs. We published about 25\+ papers in the past 15 months across leading conferences including ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI and EurIPS. Our labs are located in India (Mumbai and remote), Paris, and London.
 





 We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behavior.
 




 The Role
 


 Our current sprint on building autonomous systems for complex problems, across software engineering, data science, and AI research, involves building the harness, execution substrate and evaluation system, and each is designed to run inside a customer's environment rather than ours.
 





 This role sits underneath all three agents. The coding agent, the data science agent and the AI engineering agent look different from the outside, but they are the same system underneath: a loop that plans, acts, observes, recovers, and knows when to stop. You will build that shared layer, and the evaluation system that tells us whether any change to it made things better. Both halves matter equally. A harness we cannot measure is a harness we cannot improve.
 



****What you'll work on:****


 Harness
 



* The core agent loop and its execution model, covering orchestration, concurrency, sub\-agent coordination, cancellation, timeouts, checkpointing and resume.
* Context and state management for long\-running tasks, including retention, compaction, and how an agent reasons over what it has already done.
* The shared tool protocol, its schemas, versioning, and the internal libraries every agent team builds against.
* The execution substrate. Sandboxed environments that are reproducible, snapshot\-able and resource\-bounded, and that behave identically for a repository task, a training run and a data analysis.
* Failure semantics. Retry policy, partial failure, idempotency, and the distinction between a recoverable error and a task that should stop and hand back.
* The trace schema every agent emits, which serves at once as our debugging surface, our training signal, and the audit record our customers keep.




 Evals
 



* Task suites for each agent type, built from real work rather than synthetic benchmarks, and the infrastructure to run them at scale in parallel.
* Verifiers and scoring. Deterministic checks where the task allows it, model\-graded rubrics where it does not, and calibration of the graders themselves.
* Regression gates that run on every harness change, with cost and latency accounted alongside quality.
* The statistics to say a result is real. Seeds, variance, pass@k, confidence, and knowing how many runs are needed before anyone claims an improvement.
* Turning observed production failures into permanent test cases.
* Tooling for how we work. Trace inspection, replay, and diffing one run against another.




 You will work across all three agent teams and closely with our research team on evaluation design, post\-training and interpretability of agent behavior.
 




 What We Are Looking For
 


 This is a systems and infrastructure role. Most of the difficulty here is concurrency, state and measurement, not prompting.
 



* Strong software engineering fundamentals and advanced Python. You have shipped and operated production services, not only written them.
* Concurrency and distributed systems. Async execution, worker pools and queues, retries and idempotency, backpressure, cancellation, and reasoning clearly about what happens when a step fails halfway through.
* Containers and sandboxing. Docker and OCI internals, resource isolation, reproducible environments, and an understanding of why a job that passes locally fails in a sandbox.
* Test and CI infrastructure. You have built test harnesses, run large suites in parallel, and dealt with flakiness as an engineering problem rather than an annoyance.
* Measurement literacy. Comfort with variance, sampling and significance, and healthy skepticism toward benchmark results including your own.
* Observability instincts. Distributed tracing, structured logging, and building the inspection tooling that makes non\-deterministic systems debuggable.
* You debug systematically. You find out what actually happened rather than adjusting things until the symptom disappears.
* You are comfortable when problems are loosely specified and ownership is assumed rather than assigned.
* Experience with evaluation or benchmarking work for AI systems is a strong plus.
* Experience with agentic systems, LLM inference and serving, or developer tooling is a plus.
* Open source contributions we can read are a plus.




 We are hiring several engineers for this team at a range of experience levels, including engineers early in their careers who have strong fundamentals and want to work on agents from the infrastructure side.
 





 We move quickly and expect candidates to do the same. We value substance over polish and execution over rhetoric.

 Build cutting\-edge enterprise AI solutions, work with open\-weight models and cloud\-native deployments, and help clients translate AI ambition into measurable business outcomes.

title: User Interface Developer
description:
Software Engineer
   

  

 Mobile App Developer
   

  

 What is the User Interface Developer?
   

  

 A User Interface Developer is a professional responsible for designing and creating the visual elements of a website, application, or software program that users interact with. They focus on creating an intuitive and user\-friendly interface that enhances the overall user experience. This involves understanding user needs, designing layouts, selecting colors and fonts, and implementing interactive features. User Interface Developers often work closely with UX designers and front\-end developers to ensure that the interface meets both aesthetic and functional requirements. In summary, a User Interface Developer plays a crucial role in shaping how users interact with digital products by creating visually appealing and easy\-to\-use interfaces.
   

  

 User Interface Developer salary in Bay Area and US?
   

  

 User Interface Developers in the Bay Area typically earn higher salaries compared to the national average. According to Glassdoor, the average salary for a User Interface Developer in the Bay Area is around $110,000 per year, while the national average is approximately $80,000 per year. Factors such as experience, skills, and company size can influence salary variations within the field. Overall, User Interface Developers in the Bay Area tend to command higher salaries due to the region's high cost of living and demand for tech talent.
   

  

**Skillset Required For User Interface Developer**
 A User Interface Developer must possess a diverse skillset in order to create visually appealing and user\-friendly interfaces for websites and applications. Proficiency in front\-end web development languages such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is essential, along with experience in using frameworks like React or Angular. Knowledge of design principles and tools like Adobe XD or Sketch is also crucial for creating mockups and prototypes. Additionally, strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively with designers and developers are important qualities for a successful User Interface Developer. Brief answer: A User Interface Developer should have expertise in front\-end web development languages, design principles, and collaboration skills to create engaging and intuitive interfaces for websites and applications.
   

  

 Experience level for User Interface Developer
   

  

 The experience level required for a User Interface Developer typically ranges from entry\-level to mid\-level, depending on the specific job requirements. Entry\-level UI developers may be expected to have a basic understanding of front\-end development technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, as well as some experience with design tools like Adobe XD or Sketch. Mid\-level UI developers are usually required to have a deeper knowledge of user interface design principles, responsive design techniques, and experience working with frameworks like React or Angular. Overall, a combination of technical skills, design proficiency, and practical experience in developing user\-friendly interfaces is essential for success in this role.
   

  

 Top 3 ranking skills for User Interface Developer
   

  

 The top three ranking skills for a User Interface Developer are proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. These foundational languages are essential for creating visually appealing and interactive user interfaces. HTML is used to structure the content of a webpage, CSS is used to style and design the layout, and JavaScript is used to add functionality and interactivity. Mastering these three skills allows a UI developer to create seamless and engaging user experiences across various platforms and devices.
   

  

**Additional Knowledge Or Experience For User Interface Developer**
* Understanding of user experience principles and design thinking
* Proficiency in front\-end development languages such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
* Familiarity with responsive design techniques and frameworks like Bootstrap or Foundation


 Number of User Interface Developer jobs in US
   

  

 The number of User Interface Developer jobs in the United States has been steadily increasing over the past few years, reflecting the growing demand for professionals with expertise in designing and developing user\-friendly interfaces for websites, applications, and software. As technology continues to advance and businesses strive to enhance their digital presence, the need for skilled UI developers is expected to remain high. With a strong foundation in programming languages such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, along with a keen eye for design and usability, UI developers play a crucial role in creating engaging and intuitive user experiences across various platforms. Overall, the job outlook for UI developers in the US is promising, offering ample opportunities for those looking to pursue a career in this dynamic and evolving field.

 Software engineers design, develop, and maintain software systems and applications. They apply engineering principles to create robust, scalable, and efficient software solutions.

 Mobile app developers create applications for mobile devices like smartphones and tablets. They design, develop, and test mobile apps for iOS and Android platforms.

 Application Areas of Software Development
   

  

**Role**
 Software development roles are essential for creating various applications and systems that power our digital world. Some key application areas include:

description:

 Hyderabad, Telangana, India

 **Hyderabad studio**

 Our vision is to be EA Mobile’s center of excellence for Live Services and continue expanding EA’s leadership in the casual gaming space.
   

  

**Our Core Values**
* Tenacity – Hunger to prove yourself and push boundaries
* Ownership – Commitment to delivering results
* Passion – Deep love for the craft of making games
* Collaboration – Belief that great things are built together
* Alchemy – Bringing creativity and magic to everything you do


**Role Overview**
 We’re looking for a
 **Game Designer I** 
 to help create engaging content, live\-service experiences, and challenge\-driven gameplay for Covet Fashion. In this role, you will own design initiatives, collaborate across disciplines, and contribute to the systems, content, and experiences that bring the game to life.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a designer with strong content design fundamentals and an appreciation for fashion, creativity, and player self\-expression. You will help craft challenge themes, event experiences, and seasonal content that inspire players while supporting engagement and business goals. Covet Fashion’s experience is built around styling challenges, seasonal content, fashion trends, and a highly active live\-service ecosystem.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own and deliver content, features, and live operations initiatives, proactively identifying risks and blockers.
* Design and deliver challenge content, event experiences, and thematic concepts that enhance player engagement and creative expression.
* Create challenge briefs, styling prompts, event themes, and player\-facing content that inspire participation.
* Partner with design leads to ensure content aligns with the overall game vision, player needs, and business goals.
* Write clear and engaging challenge descriptions, event copy, and supporting content.
* Build, tune, and implement content using internal tools, game data systems, and live operations workflows.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, art, product, QA, and Live Ops teams throughout development.
* Support recurring live\-service content including Event Series, Mini\-Sets, Fashion Pass initiatives, seasonal campaigns, and other engagement programs.
* Break down ideas into actionable tasks and maintain comprehensive design documentation.
* Research fashion trends, player motivations, lifestyle trends, and competitive products to inform content and feature development.


**What You Bring**
* 3\+ years of game design experience.
* Experience working on mobile free\-to\-play games from concept through live service.
* Experience designing content, events, challenges, quests, missions, or player\-facing experiences.
* Strong understanding of player motivation, progression systems, engagement loops, and live\-service content.
* Strong writing and communication skills with the ability to create clear and compelling player\-facing content.
* Experience collaborating across design, art, engineering, production, and product teams.
* Familiarity with game data systems, live operations processes, and design\-to\-engineering workflows.
* Understanding of player psychology, pacing, game balance, retention drivers, and live\-service content expectations.
* Interest in fashion, lifestyle, creativity, customization, or self\-expression driven experiences.
* Ability to translate themes and player motivations into engaging gameplay content and experiences.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working on fashion, lifestyle, dress\-up, customization, simulation, social, or creative expression games.
* Understanding of fashion trends, styling, luxury brands, or the fashion industry.
* Background in fashion design, fashion merchandising, fashion communication, or related disciplines.
* Experience creating thematic or narrative\-driven content for live\-service games.


**Why Join Covet Fashion**
 Covet Fashion is a unique blend of creativity, competition, fashion, and community. Players participate in daily styling challenges, seasonal events, Fashion House activities, and live\-service content that continually evolves throughout the year. The game delivers thousands of fashion items, recurring seasonal launches, and event\-driven experiences that inspire self\-expression and creativity at scale.
   

  

 As a Game Designer I, you will help shape the experiences that millions of players engage with every day, combining game design, content creation, live operations, and creative thinking to deliver memorable player moments.
   

  

**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well\-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

 What is the Voice User Interface (VUI) Developer?

VUI Developers need to have a strong understanding of natural language processing, speech recognition technology, and programming languages such as Python or JavaScript. Their goal is to create seamless and intuitive voice interactions that enhance the user experience. In summary, a VUI Developer specializes in building voice\-activated interfaces that enable users to interact with devices and applications through spoken commands.
   

  

 Voice User Interface (VUI) Developer salary in Bay Area and US?

In the Bay Area, VUI Developers typically earn higher salaries compared to other regions in the US, with an average annual salary ranging from $90,000 to $150,000, depending on experience and skill level. Nationally, the average salary for VUI Developers is around $100,000 to $120,000 per year.  The experience level required for a Voice User Interface (VUI) Developer typically ranges from entry\-level to senior\-level, depending on the complexity of the projects and the specific skills needed. **About Your Team**
 Our Human Resources team operates as a strategic partner to the business, focused on cultivating a high\-performance culture where exceptional talent thrives. Our work is fundamentally guided by the DICE (Democratize Internet Commerce for Everyone) mission, which underpins our approach to all people strategies. Our core mandate centers on two critical pillars: driving world\-class Talent Density and continuously elevating Employee Experience. We achieve this by relentlessly attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber of professionals, ensuring that every individual contributes significantly to our success. Concurrently, we are committed to shaping an unparalleled employee experience—one defined by transparent communication, meaningful development, and a deeply engaging, inclusive culture. As stewards of the company's most valuable asset—its people—we design, implement, and champion people strategies that directly translate into sustained business growth and a position as one of India’s most sought\-after e\-commerce destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a highly driven and technically strong HR professional to join our team as an
   

  

 Assistant Manager – HR, with a core focus on HR systems, analytics, AI\-driven solutions, and
   

  

 automation.
   

  

 This role is not about managing processes at the surface level, it is about deep problem
   

  

 discovery, building scalable solutions, and continuously improving the employee experience
   

  

 through technology. The ideal candidate is someone who is curious, hands\-on, and user\-first,
   

  

 with the ability to break down ambiguous problems and solve them using data, systems, and
   

  

 emerging technologies like AI.
   

  

**What Will You Do**
* HR Systems Ownership (SuccessFactors \& HR Tech Stack)
* Lead the implementation and management of SAP SuccessFactors modules (implementation, configuration, enhancements, and adoption)
* Act as the functional and technical owner of the HR tech stack (HRMS, LMS, integrations)
* Continuously evaluate and improve system architecture to ensure scalability and efficiency
* Troubleshoot issues hands\-on and drive resolution with vendors/IT teams
* AI\-Driven HR Transformation
* Identify and implement AI use cases in HR (e.g., predictive analytics, chatbot automation, intelligent workflows)
* Leverage AI tools to improve decision\-making, employee experience, and operational efficiency
* Experiment with emerging tools (preferably LLMs like Gemini, ChatGPT, etc.) and translate them into real HR applications
* Drive a culture of AI\-first thinking within HR operations
* Problem Discovery \& Solutioning (User\-First Approach)
* Go beyond stated requirements to identify root problems and inefficiencies
* Apply first\-principles thinking to redesign HR processes
* Build solutions with a strong focus on employee experience and usability
* Partner with stakeholders to deeply understand pain points and translate them into scalable tech solutions
* HR Analytics \& Data Intelligence
* Build advanced dashboards, reports, and predictive models for HR metrics (attrition, hiring funnel, performance, enps)
* Work with large datasets, including data extraction, transformation, and analysis
* Enable data\-driven decision\-making across HR and leadership teams
* Bring storytelling into data, convert insights into actionable narratives
* Automation \& Workflow Optimization
* Identify and eliminate manual processes through end\-to\-end automation
* Build workflows using tools like Power Automate, Zapier, scripting (Python/SQL), or similar
* Design self\-serve HR solutions for employees and managers
* Continuously improve turnaround time, accuracy, and scalability of HR operations
* Integrations \& API Management
* Design and manage system integrations between tools
* Work with APIs, webhooks, and middleware tools for seamless data exchange
* Collaborate with other BUs, such as IT, Finance, InfoSec, and CREWS to ensure robust, secure, and scalable integrations
* Governance, Risk \& Compliance
* Ensure compliance with ITGC (IT General Controls) and audit frameworks
* Maintain strong controls around data privacy, access management, and system integrity
* Support internal and external audits with proper documentation and system readiness
* Stakeholder Collaboration \& Enablement
* Work closely with HR, IT, Finance, InfoSec, and CREWS teams.
* Translate business needs into technical and system solutions
* Drive adoption through training, documentation, and change management


**Experience**
**What you will need:**
* 3–6 years in HR Operations / HR Tech / People Analytics
* Hands\-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors (implementation/configuration is a must)


**Technical Skills**
* Strong in HR analytics (Advanced Excel, SQL, BI tools like Power BI/Tableau)
* Hands\-on experience with automation tools and scripting
* Working knowledge of APIs, integrations, and system architecture
* Practical exposure to AI tools and applications in HR
* Strong understanding of data structures and workflows


**Other Skills**
* Strong stakeholder management and communication
* High ownership and accountability
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment

 Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.
   

  

 Honeywell Aerospace Products And Services Are Found On Aircraft Across Commercial Aviation, Defense And Space. We Operate Through Three Business Areas

* Engines \& Power Systems provides the propulsion, auxiliary power and electrical systems that keep those aircraft flying

* Strong experience in supporting manufacturing or industrial environments
* Strong knowledge of labor laws and regulations
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to build and maintain positive relationships with employees
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Labor Relations, or related field


**WE VALUE**
* Leadership, problem and conflict solving skills
* Attention to detail, analytical skills, process orientation
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information

title: AI Agent Engineer - Evals & Harness
description:
**Lexsi Labs is the leading frontier AI lab focused on building aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems** 
 . While that is the vision, the mission is to build safety aware autonomous systems in the extreme near term. Our research work spans areas like AI alignment methodologies, interpretability\-led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and new autonomous system designs. We published about 25\+ papers in the past 15 months across leading conferences including ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI and EurIPS. Our labs are located in India (Mumbai and remote), Paris, and London.
 



  





 We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behavior.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Our current sprint on building autonomous systems for complex problems, across software engineering, data science, and AI research, involves building the harness, execution substrate and evaluation system, and each is designed to run inside a customer's environment rather than ours.
 



  





 This role sits underneath all three agents. The coding agent, the data science agent and the AI engineering agent look different from the outside, but they are the same system underneath: a loop that plans, acts, observes, recovers, and knows when to stop. You will build that shared layer, and the evaluation system that tells us whether any change to it made things better. Both halves matter equally. A harness we cannot measure is a harness we cannot improve.
 



  





**What you'll work on:** 




 Harness
 


* The core agent loop and its execution model, covering orchestration, concurrency, sub\-agent coordination, cancellation, timeouts, checkpointing and resume.
* Context and state management for long\-running tasks, including retention, compaction, and how an agent reasons over what it has already done.
* The shared tool protocol, its schemas, versioning, and the internal libraries every agent team builds against.
* The execution substrate. Sandboxed environments that are reproducible, snapshot\-able and resource\-bounded, and that behave identically for a repository task, a training run and a data analysis.
* Failure semantics. Retry policy, partial failure, idempotency, and the distinction between a recoverable error and a task that should stop and hand back.
* The trace schema every agent emits, which serves at once as our debugging surface, our training signal, and the audit record our customers keep.



 Evals
 


* Task suites for each agent type, built from real work rather than synthetic benchmarks, and the infrastructure to run them at scale in parallel.
* Verifiers and scoring. Deterministic checks where the task allows it, model\-graded rubrics where it does not, and calibration of the graders themselves.
* Regression gates that run on every harness change, with cost and latency accounted alongside quality.
* The statistics to say a result is real. Seeds, variance, pass@k, confidence, and knowing how many runs are needed before anyone claims an improvement.
* Turning observed production failures into permanent test cases.
* Tooling for how we work. Trace inspection, replay, and diffing one run against another.



 You will work across all three agent teams and closely with our research team on evaluation design, post\-training and interpretability of agent behavior.
 



  





  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 This is a systems and infrastructure role. Most of the difficulty here is concurrency, state and measurement, not prompting.
 


* Strong software engineering fundamentals and advanced Python. You have shipped and operated production services, not only written them.
* Concurrency and distributed systems. Async execution, worker pools and queues, retries and idempotency, backpressure, cancellation, and reasoning clearly about what happens when a step fails halfway through.
* Containers and sandboxing. Docker and OCI internals, resource isolation, reproducible environments, and an understanding of why a job that passes locally fails in a sandbox.
* Test and CI infrastructure. You have built test harnesses, run large suites in parallel, and dealt with flakiness as an engineering problem rather than an annoyance.
* Measurement literacy. Comfort with variance, sampling and significance, and healthy skepticism toward benchmark results including your own.
* Observability instincts. Distributed tracing, structured logging, and building the inspection tooling that makes non\-deterministic systems debuggable.
* You debug systematically. You find out what actually happened rather than adjusting things until the symptom disappears.
* You are comfortable when problems are loosely specified and ownership is assumed rather than assigned.
* Experience with evaluation or benchmarking work for AI systems is a strong plus.
* Experience with agentic systems, LLM inference and serving, or developer tooling is a plus.
* Open source contributions we can read are a plus.



  





 We are hiring several engineers for this team at a range of experience levels, including engineers early in their careers who have strong fundamentals and want to work on agents from the infrastructure side.
 



  





 We move quickly and expect candidates to do the same. We value substance over polish and execution over rhetoric.

 As a Red Team Operator within the Offensive Security team, you will participate in adversary emulation exercises and security assessments that test the resilience of BCG’s people, processes, and technology. You will develop your offensive security skills in a structured environment, gaining hands\-on experience across a broad range of attack techniques and defensive technologies.
   

  

 You will work alongside senior red team practitioners on end\-to\-end engagements, contributing to technical execution while building your understanding of adversary tradecraft, threat intelligence, and enterprise security architectures. This is an excellent opportunity for a security professional looking to grow within a world\-class offensive security program.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Support the planning and execution of red team engagements, including reconnaissance, initial access, post\-exploitation, and lateral movement phases.
* Conduct phishing simulations, social engineering campaigns, and assume\-breach exercises under the direction of senior team members.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of offensive tooling, attack infrastructure, and automation scripts to support engagement operations.
* Perform vulnerability assessments and penetration testing across network, endpoint, web application, and cloud environments.
* Document attack paths, findings, and technical evidence to support high\-quality engagement reports.
* Contribute to purple team exercises by collaborating with detection and response teams to validate and improve security controls.
* Research emerging attack techniques, threat actor TTPs, and AI led offensive security tooling to enhance team capabilities.
* Participate in post\-engagement reviews and knowledge\-sharing sessions to support continuous improvement of Red Team methodologies.
* Assist in maintaining and operating command\-and\-control infrastructure and offensive security platforms.
* Support the development of internal training materials, playbooks, and documentation for the Offensive Security team.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 1–3 years of experience in offensive security, penetration testing, or a related cybersecurity discipline.
* Foundational knowledge of enterprise attack techniques across Active Directory, endpoints, networks, and web applications.
* Exposure to common offensive security tools and frameworks such as Metasploit, BloodHound, Burp Suite, or equivalent.
* Basic scripting or programming skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash for task automation and tooling support.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, operating system internals, and common security protocols.
* Familiarity with the MITRE ATT\&CK framework and common adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a keen interest in understanding how attackers think and operate.
* Ability to document technical findings clearly and communicate results to peers and team leads.
* Eagerness to learn, take direction from senior practitioners, and grow within a structured offensive security program.
* Exposure to cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud) is advantageous.
* Participation in CTF competitions, bug bounty programs, or personal security research projects is valued.
* Familiarity with basic reverse engineering, malware analysis, or exploit research is a bonus.
* Understanding of defensive security concepts and technologies such as SIEM, EDR, and network monitoring is beneficial.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 You will be part of the Global Information Security organization, embedded within the Offensive Security team. You will work alongside senior red team practitioners, gaining exposure to a wide range of adversary emulation techniques and security assessment methodologies.
   

  

 You will also interact with Incident Response teams, Security Operations, Information Technology, and Infrastructure colleagues as part of collaborative purple team exercises and cross\-functional security improvement initiatives.

 This is an internal corporate security role supporting BCG’s global cybersecurity program.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose**
 Implement risk management processes at the ground level for the construction finance business, gaining a thorough understanding of the project and developer and preparing a credit memo to assess the project viability and proposal structure as per ABHFL risk parameters and customer requirements. Key activities are analysis of project viability, assessment of market information and developer financials.
   

  

**Job Context \& Major Challenges**
**Job Context/ Job Challenges**
 Job Context
   

  

**Key Aspects**
 The company has a well\-defined vision of being one of the most reputed and material financiers within the lending space\-spread across both retail HNI and corporate clientele. We have made significant investments in our process and system infrastructure towards preparing for the next level of growth and are one of the only financial entities certified for ISO 9001:2008 across all our business processes. Spread across 18 cities, we plan on further diversifying our risk and revenue mix through expansion into new geographies and new product segments allowing our customers a one\-window shop for all their financing needs.
   

  

 The Business Credit Analyst is an integral part of the Construction Finance Business and is responsible for analyzing the proposals with the required due diligence and to ensure that all information required to take a credit decision is captured in the proposal.
   

  

 The analyst is also responsible to ensure that proposals are compliant with all the norms of credit policy, RBI regulations and other statutory regulations.
   

  

 He/she has to maintain stipulated TAT in credit appraisal process and is also responsible for keeping update on the various changes in economic scenario, sectors, etc., co\-ordination with sales team and RMG for faster decisions to improvise TATs of the overall sanction process.
   

  

 Market Intelligence and understanding Competition best practices and suggesting changes in the existing product / policy and processes.
   

  

 Generating various MISs and EWS (early warning signals), overall portfolio monitoring form risk as well as compliance perspective is an important job aspect.
   

  

 Key Challenges
   

  

 Cross functional coordination to enable timely approval of credit proposals
   

  

 Self\-updating on economic / sectoral changes in the economy
   

  

 Improvising on TAT
   

  

 Seamless co\-ordination with multiple internal and external entities
   

  

 New product development
   

  

**Enabling Skill Sets \& Qualifications**
 The critical skill sets are a strong analytical acumen, evaluation skills, detail orientation \& decision\-making skills, initiative \& target orientation \& market intelligence developed through a strong industry network.
   

  

 The education \& experience required to fulfil this profile are a Chartered Accountant or an MBA with minimum 2\-4 years of experience in credit and risk functions of Banks/NBFCs.
   

  

**Key Result Areas**
**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** 
**Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**
 KRA1 To Assess and conduct detailed credit analysis \& evaluation of lending proposals for approval / decision at the local level or further recommendation for approval/ decision to Risk team for further approval at CC level Meet with developers and builders to understand the viability of their projects, in terms of project scale, progress and financials. Provide inputs towards the structuring of the deal, ensuring compliance with internal risk and external regulatory requirements. Carry out an analysis of the balance sheet and recent financial results of developers and their organizations. Carry out background research on the project, the developer and the regional market, highlighting any negative reports so as to ensure the quality of ABHFLs lending portfoli. To interact with the Legal and Technical agencies to ensure that property risk have been understood and mitigated. Monitor statutory real estate guidelines and assess any relevant information from these sources
   

  

 KRA2 Emphasize strict compliance and adherence to internal risk management and external regulatory norms Ensure a thorough understanding and acceptance of the ABFL credit risk strategies, and ensure that appropriate credit risk parameters are incorporated in proposals. To work with the Central Risk teams to identify risk areas and build processes to mitigate risk, including performance metrics and documented procedures. Monitor customer accounts on a periodic basis to ensure the maintenance of acceptable asset quality levels. Track delinquent and potentially problematic accounts closely, taking action to minimize the level of NPAs within the region.
   

  

 KRA3 Vendor Management Identifying and recommendation for Appointment of vendors at local levels including valuation, legal, Field Investigation Agencies, Fraud Containment Agencies. Managing TAT with various vendors\- a) Field investigation, b) Lawyers, c) Technical Valuers, d) RCU agency to ensure Customer Delight. Regular Training and reviewing the performance of the vendors with regular interaction and keeping eye on the other financial institution association.
   

  

 KRA4 Process Management Ensuring that end to end processes are followed as per the SOPs as defined for CF at the local assessment level. Continuous improvement in credit approval process to meet the dynamic business needs and instituting mechanisms for adherence of risk associated with the product s, safety of financed amount and customer satisfaction. Proper capturing of data in the requisite system to ensure proper MIS generation for business decisions. Training implementation for Local Credit Process team, Sales team on product, processes, legal and technical aspects. Handling customer escalations and complaints during and post disbursements \-replies to mailers, correspondences with co\-ordination with the legal team

This is not a conventional HR administration role. The ideal candidate should be capable of taking ownership of HR operations end\-to\-end—from **manpower planning and talent acquisition to payroll, performance management, policies, employee engagement, compliance, and organizational development**.

You will work closely with the management team to build a high\-performance organization with the right people, processes, culture, and systems in place.

Key Responsibilities1\. HR Strategy \& Organizational Development

* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with Aspireon Ventures' business goals.
* Build HR systems and processes suitable for a growing multi\-vertical organization.
* Develop organizational structures, reporting frameworks, job roles, and HR workflows.
* Work closely with management on manpower planning and workforce requirements.
* Support the organization in building a strong and performance\-driven culture.

2\. Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment

* Own the complete recruitment lifecycle from identifying manpower requirements to onboarding.
* Develop effective recruitment strategies for creative, academic, corporate, sales, media, and operational roles.
* Create and optimize Job Descriptions and hiring processes.
* Source candidates through Indeed, LinkedIn, recruitment platforms, referrals, and other channels.
* Conduct initial screening and coordinate interviews with department heads and management.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future requirements.
* Reduce hiring turnaround time while maintaining quality of recruitment.

3\. Payroll \& Compensation

* Manage monthly payroll processes and ensure accurate and timely salary processing.
* Maintain employee salary structures, incentives, deductions, attendance, leave, and payroll records.
* Coordinate with accounts/finance teams for payroll\-related activities.
* Assist management in developing compensation structures and employee benefits.

4\. HR Policies \& Compliance

* Develop, implement, and maintain company HR policies and procedures.
* Ensure proper documentation of employment\-related processes.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Establish proper processes for attendance, leave, probation, confirmation, resignation, and full \& final settlement.

5\. Performance Management

* Design and implement employee performance evaluation systems.
* Establish KRAs/KPIs in coordination with department heads.
* Manage probation, confirmation, performance reviews, promotions, and increments.
* Identify performance gaps and coordinate improvement plans.
* Help build a culture of accountability and measurable performance.

6\. Employee Engagement \& Culture

* Build a positive, professional, and collaborative workplace culture.
* Develop employee engagement initiatives and internal communication systems.
* Address employee concerns and grievances professionally.
* Improve employee retention and overall employee experience.
* Act as a trusted bridge between management and employees.

7\. Learning \& Development

* Identify training and development requirements across departments.
* Coordinate internal and external training programs.
* Develop employee development plans based on organizational requirements.
* Support leadership in building future\-ready teams.

8\. HR Operations \& Administration

* Manage onboarding and employee induction processes.
* Maintain accurate employee databases and HR documentation.
* Monitor attendance, leave, working hours, and employee records.
* Manage employee lifecycle processes from joining to exit.
* Prepare regular HR reports and workforce analytics for management.

What We Are Looking For

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **3–6 years of relevant experience in HR**, preferably in a growing company, startup, education, media, creative, or multi\-business environment.
* Strong experience in **end\-to\-end HR management**.
* Proven ability to independently build HR systems and processes.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment, payroll, performance management, employee relations, and HR policies.
* Good understanding of applicable labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to work closely with founders/management and department heads.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in HRMS, MS Office/Google Workspace, and recruitment platforms.

Preferred Skills

Candidates with experience in any of the following environments will be preferred:

* Startups or fast\-growing organizations
* Education / EdTech
* Media \& Entertainment
* Creative agencies
* Digital marketing / content companies
* Multi\-location organizations
* Organizations undergoing rapid team expansion

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

* **Thinks beyond traditional HR.**
* Can build HR systems from scratch.

description:
**Job Title:** HR Intern Learning \& Development (L\&D)

**Duration** : 6 Months

**About the Role**

We are looking for an enthusiastic and proactive **Learning \& Development (L\&D) Intern** to support our growing learning initiatives and the implementation of our Learning Management System (LMS). This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in corporate learning, training coordination, and HR processes while working closely with the L\&D team.

The selected intern will receive structured guidance and training and will play a key role in ensuring the smooth execution of learning programs and employee development initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external training vendors to ensure seamless execution of learning programs.
* Track and follow up on ongoing learning initiatives, training nominations, and completion status.
* Support the planning, coordination, and follow\-up of Pulse Surveys.
* Maintain training records, learning dashboards, and trackers with high accuracy.
* Assist in coordinating employee engagement activities, wellness programs, and recognition initiatives.
* Assist with Learning Management System (LMS) administration, including learner enrollment, course assignments, reporting, and user support once the platform is implemented.
* Provide administrative and operational support for various employee learning and development activities.

**What You'll Gain**

* Practical exposure to end\-to\-end Learning \& Development operations.
* Hands\-on experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* Opportunity to work on employee engagement and learning initiatives.
* Mentorship and on\-the\-job training from experienced L\&D professionals.
* Exposure to corporate HR and learning processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Recently completed a Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of Learning \& Development or HR processes.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good coordination and follow\-up abilities.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
* Detail\-oriented with good organizational and time management skills.
* Eagerness to learn, take initiative, and work in a collaborative environment.

**Key Competencies**

* Excellent communication skills
* Coordination and stakeholder management
* Ownership and accountability
* Proactive mindset
* Attention to detail
* Adaptability and willingness to learn
* Team collaboration

title: Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) Engineer
company: kinemach engineering and machines pvt ltd
description:
About Kinemach

Kinemach is a manufacturing technology and solutions company based in Pune, designing and building assembly automation lines, material handling and robotics systems, processing equipment, packaging machinery, and inspection/testing systems for customers across automotive, pharmaceutical, food processing, electronics, and rubber/plastics industries. Our product portfolio includes two specialised brands: Procer Mixing, which manufactures high\-shear mixers, homogenizers, and turnkey process plants for the food, pharmaceutical, and cosmetics industries, built to GMP and precision rotor\-stator tolerances; and DynaScrew, which manufactures precision automatic screw\-feeding and driving systems used in automotive, electronics, aerospace, and medical\-device assembly.

Because our machines are custom\-engineered, precision\-built, and shipped to customers who expect documented, repeatable quality, QA/QC is central to how we deliver \- from the raw material and bought\-out components that come in, through machining and assembly, to the functional testing and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) before a machine leaves our facility.

Role Summary

We are looking for a QA/QC Engineer to own quality checks across all three product lines \- Kinemach's automation and assembly systems, Procer's mixing and homogenizing equipment, and DynaScrew's screw\-feeding and driving systems. This is a hands\-on, shop\-floor role: you will inspect incoming materials and components, verify in\-process machining and assembly against engineering drawings, run functional and calibration checks on finished sub\-assemblies and machines, and maintain the inspection records and documentation our customers and quality systems require.

Key Responsibilities

\- Perform incoming quality inspection of raw materials, castings, and bought\-out components (motors, sensors, PLCs, pneumatics, fasteners) against purchase specifications and drawings.

\- Carry out in\-process dimensional inspection during machining and fabrication using standard measuring instruments (verniers, micrometers, dial/height gauges); read and verify parts against engineering drawings and GD\&T callouts.

\- Conduct functional and calibration testing on assembled sub\-systems \- for example torque verification and screw\-feed accuracy on DynaScrew stations, and rotor\-stator clearance, leak, and CIP/SIP checks on Procer mixing equipment.

\- Support final inspection and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) of completed machines prior to dispatch, including preparing FAT checklists and test records for customer sign\-off.

\- Raise, document, and track Non\-Conformance Reports (NCRs); coordinate with production, design, and vendors on root cause and corrective actions.

\- Maintain calibration schedules and records for measuring and test instruments, and ensure traceability of inspection data.

\- Prepare and maintain quality documentation \- inspection reports, quality plans, test certificates \- in line with ISO 9001 requirements, and GMP\-related documentation for Procer's pharma/food equipment where applicable.

\- Assist with vendor/supplier quality evaluation and periodic audits of incoming material quality.

\- Flag recurring quality issues on the shop floor and support continuous improvement in inspection methods and process controls.

Requirements

\- Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Production, Industrial, or Mechatronics Engineering (or equivalent).

\- 0\-3 years of experience in a QA/QC, quality inspection, or manufacturing quality role \- freshers with strong fundamentals and internship/project exposure to inspection are welcome to apply.

\- Working knowledge of standard measuring instruments (vernier caliper, micrometer, dial/height gauge); exposure to CMM is a plus.

\- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, including basic GD\&T.

\- Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management concepts and basic documentation practices (inspection reports, NCRs, calibration records).

\- Comfortable working on the shop floor across machining, assembly, and testing areas, not only at a desk.

\- Good communication skills to coordinate with production, design, and vendors; proficiency with MS Office (Excel in particular).

Preferred (Good to Have)

\- Prior exposure to capital equipment, custom machine building, or low\-volume/high\-mix manufacturing rather than mass\-production QA.

\- Familiarity with GMP requirements or quality expectations for pharmaceutical/food processing equipment.

\- Basic exposure to electromechanical or mechatronic system testing (torque tools, sensors, PLC\-driven equipment).

What We Offer

\- Direct, hands\-on exposure to three distinct engineering product lines \- automation, precision mixing/process equipment, and precision fastening systems \- under one roof.

\- Close mentorship from senior engineering and quality teams on custom machine\-building practices not typically seen in mass\-production QA roles.

\- A shop\-floor\-first culture where quality engineers work directly alongside design, machining, and assembly teams.

Location: Pune, Maharashtra (On\-site)

Experience: 0\-3 years

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
